description: Authoritative log of every directory or file moved into _quarantine/. Each entry MUST be added in the same commit that performs the physical move. Phase 3 added the first entry (AI-OS stray paste-debris encountered during platform module promotion). Phase 3.5 added the four legacy `platform-module.manifest.json` files (DAuth, DOS, DSOC, DNOC) after they were promoted to canonical v1 `module.manifest.json` files at `platform/<x>/module.manifest.json`. Phase 4A added the orphaned foundation contract publisher script + smoke test (their TS source `foundation.module-contract.ts` does not exist in the fresh baseline) plus three chat-paste stray files at the root of Compliance/Risk/Workflow Module/ that escaped earlier reviews. Phase 6/Wave-1 added the 12 timestamped `.bak.*` files left at repo top-level by previous batch operations (no rollback target ever consumed them; the canonical files they shadowed are already in production-shape).

entries.phase: Phase 3.5 — manifest standardization

Promoted to canonical v1 path `platform/dauth/module.manifest.json` with all rich metadata (schemas, events, routes, security, observability, etc.) preserved verbatim under `metadata.*`.
entries.notes: Canonical replacement: platform/dauth/module.manifest.json. The new manifest's `metadata.previousManifest` field documents the legacy path for audit. Legacy file retained in quarantine until Phase 6 final sweep so the move is reversible.

entries.phase: Phase 4A — Shahin-AI website promotion
entries.reason: Script reads `foundation.module-contract.ts` and parses an `export const FOUNDATION_CONTRACT` literal. The TS source file does not exist anywhere in the fresh-baseline worktree (verified via Glob, find, and `git log --diff-filter=D`). Only `FOUNDATION_CONTRACT_VERSION` exists in `platform/foundation/contracts/v1/index.ts`. Running this script today throws ENOENT.
entries.notes: See _quarantine/orphaned-foundation-publisher/README.md for the full restoration plan. Existing JSON snapshot at platform/dynamic-ui/db/public/seeds/foundation-contract.json remains the source of truth for downstream dynamic-ui drift checks until the TS contract is re-authored.
